xccdf-1.2:Profile.xccdf-1.2:title: DISA STIG for RHEL 10 - SSH No Empty Passwords
xccdf-1.2:Profile.xccdf-1.2:description: Customized profile based on the Red Hat STIG for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 that scans only for the OpenSSH empty password rule (PermitEmptyPasswords no), rather than the full STIG rule set.
